bead.title: Feed embedded fjord through the delivery seam beside the HTTP sink
bead.description: PROBLEM: the server boots only the niflheim HTTP delivery path; ADR-014's embedded-fjord binding needs a sibling startup/config seam. Wire the embedded fjord feed as a second ChangeRecordSink consumer beside the HTTP sink (same seam, feed-forward only, never on the commit path — CL-2). The optional external-Kafka PRODUCER sink (deployment mode where the embedded fjord idles) shares this seam; implement the seam so both attachments are config-selectable.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestChangeRecordSinkConfigSelectsKafkaProducerPath` proves config can choose the Kafka/heimq sink without breaking the HTTP default.
2. `TestChangeRecordEmitterStartsChosenSinkOnly` proves startup only spawns the selected sink path.
3. `go test ./... -run 'TestChangeRecordSinkConfigSelectsKafkaProducerPath|TestChangeRecordEmitterStartsChosenSinkOnly'`
4. `lefthook run pre-commit`
5. `lefthook run pre-push`
